title: Ansys Tokyo Intern, Co-Op Tokyo, Japan Category: Interns/Temp Posted: 10/26/2026 Job ID: 19487
Design Verification- Intern
description:
About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact Join a highly skilled development team, driving the development of Marvell's next-generation network switches. Our team is responsible for a wide range of IPs for switching products, from initial definition through architecture, design, and verification. As an intern, you will learn switch architecture, design and verification development tools and modern methodologies. You will be doing hands-on development tasks and learn to become an experienced engineer. You will learn system verilog, UVM, Python, C++, using AI tools, and how to implement and verify complex features. You will investigate and implement new protocols and features and verify them to tapeout quality. We are looking for excellent students, able to handle complex problems, with excellent people relations and collaboration skills. What You Can Expect Implement new design and verification features. Reach high-frequency, high-performance, and low-power targets. Write a verification test plan using random techniques and coverage analysis. Develop a complex object-oriented random verification environment using System Verilog/UVM. Create tests and tune the environment to achieve coverage goals. Own and debug failures in simulation to root-cause problems. Analysis/closure of code and functional coverage. Use scripting languages to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency. What We're Looking For Candidate pursuing a B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, EE, or a related technical field. At least 1.5 years remaining until graduation. Good understanding of object-oriented programming and digital logic. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team. Excellent problem-solving skills. 

 Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. title: Intern - Product Test Development Engineer
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Do you love the interaction of cutting-edge hardware and innovative software solutions? In today's data economy, Micron's memory and storage products are essential to advancing state of the art computing technology. Continued scaling of memory technology presents challenges that require complex and creative testing solutions. As a Core Test Development Engineer in the Test Solutions Engineering department, you will be responsible for the development, debug and maintenance of test programs that help deliver Micron's world-class DRAM portfolio to market. A 'Core' test development engineer is specifically focused on the health and quality of the memory cells [DRAM features 16 billion cells in less than 80mm^2 of area]. This role will leverage AI and Generative AI enabled tools where appropriate to accelerate technical problem solving, software development, data analysis, and engineering productivity. As test engineers, we must constantly evolve and apply the right technology and testing solution, including emerging AI capabilities, to be successful! We need your passion and excitement to help take the team to the next level! Responsibilities A successful test development engineer must develop a good understanding of test equipment hardware, device knowledge and software systems. Develop, debug and support test programs from new product introduction phase up through high volume manufacturing Write test programs and support scripts in C++, Python Utilize AI and Generative AI enabled tools to improve software development, test program debug, data analysis, technical problem solving, and engineering productivity Contribute input and feedback to help define next generation 'design for test' capabilities Analyze device and test flow data, including the use of AI enabled methods where appropriate, to make informed test coverage decisions Balance test time objectives while maintaining optimal yield and quality Collaborate with partners in Product Engineering, Fab, Manufacturing, Yield Enhancement, Global Quality, Systems Integration Group, and Equipment Engineering teams to deliver the right test solution Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Demonstrated understanding of basic resistance, inductance, and capacitance (R/L/C) circuit concepts, digital systems, logic gates, and CMOS transistor operation. Intermediate or advanced programming capability in C++ or Python . Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic statistics and data analytics. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information effectively and collaborate with others. Preferred Qualifications Experience applying electrical circuit and CMOS fundamentals to hardware testing, characterization, or troubleshooting. Experience developing, debugging, or maintaining engineering or test software using C++ or Python . Experience analyzing engineering or test data using statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, or anomalies. Experience working with software development and data-analysis workflows in a Unix/Linux environment. Proficiency using AI or Generative AI tools to support technical problem solving, software development, data analysis, or engineering productivity . title: Intern - Product Yield Software Engineer
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. As an Intern Product Yield Enhancement (PYE) Software Engineer at Micron Technology, you will help develop software and automation solutions that enable engineers to analyze semiconductor manufacturing and product data more efficiently. PYE engineers work across Research and Development, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, and Global Quality to help take next-generation devices from design to mass production. In this software-focused role, you will work alongside PYE engineers to develop practical tools that turn large and complex engineering datasets into useful information. Projects may include data processing and visualization, engineering workflow automation, web-based tools, AI-assisted engineering applications, and improvements to existing PYE software systems. This internship is intended to provide a hands-on engineering project where you can apply software development skills to real semiconductor manufacturing problems and see the impact of your work. This is a 3-month internship. Responsibilities Your job duties may include: Develop and improve software tools used by PYE engineers for engineering analysis and decision-making. Create automation for processing, analyzing, and visualizing semiconductor manufacturing and product data. Work with large engineering datasets to identify useful patterns, trends, and relationships. Develop scripts, applications, dashboards, reports, or web-based engineering tools. Explore practical applications of AI-assisted engineering and software development. Improve existing engineering workflows through automation and software integration. Debug, test, document, and maintain software used by engineering teams. Collaborate with PYE engineers to understand engineering problems and translate them into effective software solutions. Communicate project results and demonstrate completed tools to engineers and management. During the internship, you'll have an opportunity to: Build software that engineers can use to solve real manufacturing and product problems. Gain experience working with large-scale semiconductor engineering data. Learn how software, data analytics, and semiconductor engineering come together in a high-volume manufacturing environment. Work directly with experienced engineers and software users. Take ownership of a project from problem definition through implementation and demonstration. Explore how modern AI and automation technologies can improve engineering workflows. Minimum Qualifications Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field . Experience programming in at least one language such as Perl, Python, C/C++, Java, or similar . Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and engineering concepts. Expected graduation date must not be before September 1, 2027 . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Perl . Familiarity with SQL and relational databases . Experience with Linux/Unix environments. Familiarity with web development technologies. Experience working with data visualization or reporting tools. Familiarity with Git or other source-control systems. Exposure to statistics, data science, machine learning, or AI tools. Experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity. Semiconductor knowledge is helpful but not required . Ability to work effectively in a diverse, fast-paced engineering environment. Excellent communication skills. Self-motivation, curiosity, and enthusiasm for solving real engineering problems. title: Intern - HBM Data Scientist
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Department Overview The Data Science team employs advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI technologies to improve semiconductor manufacturing performance and decision-making. By combining statistical methods, engineering expertise, and AI-enabled solutions, the team transforms complex manufacturing data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence and innovation across Micron. Position Overview As a Data Science Intern, you will work at the intersection of statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI agents to solve real-world semiconductor manufacturing challenges. You will apply time-series analytics, change-point detection, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) technologies to identify important patterns in manufacturing data and develop AI-enabled solutions that help engineers make better decisions. Responsibilities Apply statistical and machine learning techniques, including time-series analysis, change-point detection, clustering, and dimensionality reduction, to identify trends and anomalies in semiconductor manufacturing data. Develop and evaluate AI agents and LLM-enabled workflows by integrating analysis tools, designing prompts, and assessing model performance against known outcomes. Extract, clean, integrate, and analyze data using SQL, Python, and analytical tools to support engineering investigations and decision-making. Build reproducible analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide actionable insights to engineering teams. Present technical findings, recommendations, and limitations clearly to engineering partners while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Minimum Qualifications 0-2 years of relevant experience through coursework, research, internships, academic projects, hackathons, or data science competitions. Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. Experience with Python for data analysis, including libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or similar tools, and basic SQL for data extraction and preparation. Knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, hypothesis testing, regression, clustering, PCA, and data analysis methodologies gained through coursework or projects. Experience using AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, or generative AI platforms through academic, personal, or project-based work, along with strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with time-series analysis, forecasting, anomaly detection, change-point detection, or statistical modeling techniques. Familiarity with LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, prompt engineering, or AI workflow orchestration frameworks. Experience evaluating AI model performance, validating outputs, mitigating hallucinations, or developing AI-assisted applications and workflows. Proficiency with data science and machine learning tools such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, SciPy, R, JMP, Plotly, or similar platforms. Experience applying analytics, machine learning, or AI technologies to manufacturing, engineering, scientific research, or other real-world datasets, with an interest in semiconductor manufacturing and industrial analytics.
